field_principles.champion_challenger_pairing_and_decision: Release decisions use paired champion--challenger comparisons.
field_principles.chronological_partition_contract: Partition counts and visibility rules prevent replay-only claims.
field_principles.continuous_state_and_exact_energy_hashes: State trajectories and exact outcome energies are content-addressed.
field_principles.cross_family_transfer_count: Bare zero proves no model-family or task-family transfer occurred.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time is recorded without padding.
field_principles.exp6304_path_hash_and_terminal_class: Exp6304 is pinned as the positive baseline source.
field_principles.factor_graph_schema_and_hash: The factor graph schema defines the only mutable factor set.
field_principles.field_principles: Every required field carries its guard principle.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every field maps to spec, inputs, receipts, metrics, tests, or hashes.
field_principles.first_attempt_exact_rate_refinement_work: Accuracy, refinement, regret, retention, forgetting, and harm remain partitioned.
field_principles.frozen_full_state_factor_local_and_oracl: Each arm has a defined role and outcome authority.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict starts with a terminal prefix and states whether versioned factor-local learning earned readiness.
field_principles.immutable_predecision_snapshots: Every arm-event prediction is persisted before outcome reveal.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The run declares deterministic exact ASP initializer learning with no base model load.
field_principles.initializer_architecture_and_parameter_c: The initializer architecture and mutable parameter count are explicit.
field_principles.matched_update_and_verifier_budgets: Update and exact verifier budgets match across learning arms.
field_principles.monitoring_degradation_and_parent_rollba: Degradation monitoring rolls back byte-exactly to parents.
field_principles.movement_memory_and_update_cost_by_arm: Each arm reports changed factors, bytes, updates, memory, and movement.
field_principles.paired_intervals_and_sample_sizes: Primary contrasts include paired deltas and sample sizes.
field_principles.paper_sources_and_local_claim_boundary: OpenLoopEvolve and Beyond Binary are design cues only. Local claims stop at same-domain initializer state.
field_principles.postdecision_exact_outcome_receipts: Exact outcomes open only after predecision snapshots exist.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Inputs, seeds, validators, budgets, degradation rules, factor graph, reference, and protected files are frozen first.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Conductor, ops, and traceability files stay byte-identical.
field_principles.random_seeds: Stream, version, boundary, and interval seeds are fixed.
field_principles.reference_snapshot_path_and_hash: The copied Exp6304-style reference state is immutable and hash-pinned.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The normalized payload checksum detects drift.
field_principles.reversal_poison_restart_and_rollback_res: Reversal, poison, restart, and rollback cannot hide in pooled utility.
field_principles.sealed_stream_manifest_path_and_hash: The manifest proves chronology and hidden-target commitments were frozen.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: Bare zero proves absent base weights were not mutated.
field_principles.status: Terminal state follows stream sealing, version gates, release, rollback, and verification.
field_principles.task_boundary_release_receipts: Passing challengers activate only at later task boundaries.
field_principles.test_commands: Focused tests, coverage, full pytest, spec coverage, E2E reading, run command, validation, adversarial checks, and root-clutter checks are listed.
field_principles.unsafe_commit_count: Bare zero proves no unsafe candidate committed.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Bare true states that exact validators are outcome authorities.
field_principles.version_parent_and_changed_factor_receip: Candidate lineage and factor attribution are explicit.
field_principles.version_registry_path_and_hash: Version rows are append-only and content-addressed.
field_principles.versioned_factor_local_learning_ready_sc: Readiness is conjunctive and excludes replay-only gain.

frozen_exp6304_style.role: frozen clone of Exp6304-style reference state

honest_verdict: complete_positive: versioned factor-local learning passed boundary release and rollback gates

paper_sources_and_local_claim_boundary.local_claim_boundary: This run updates only versioned same-domain initializer state. It does not load, mutate, or transfer across base model families or task families.

Beyond Binary.local_use: factor graph, lazy updates, and movement-cost accounting

OpenLoopEvolve.local_use: versioned parent lineage, paired challenger gate, boundary release, and rollback

degradation_rules.natural_retention_dip: rollback when parent beats active on retention monitor
degradation_rules.planted_reversal: rollback when parent beats active on reversal monitor

validators.oracle: event validator_key must match hidden target commitment
